payload.title: M3 Structured rubric items with cited evidence
payload.description: Rubric as items with stable ids and kinds (include, exclude, guidance; supporting questions are items too) rendered so the decision prompt stays equivalent (accuracy must not move; measure it). Optimizer proposes add/change/retire per item citing training item ids; reject citations not in the briefing window. Carry item history across versions. Record which items applied to each decision, honesty first. Weeks; may split into M3a (structure with prompt equivalence) and M3b (optimizer item operations with validated citations). Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/Jg1DpixLFcAvnPy7d9RNDE
